notes.title: Update 3: New Map!
notes.content:
Changelog for Update 3: 

- Fall damage on the UI, when you fall from too high (and you're not it) you will be frozen for a second
- Added a resolution picker so you can change the resolution of your game

NEW MAP

The Hippo has been working hard to make another map for everyone to enjoy, Map 7 has some fun moving parts and a lot of powerups so players can have a blast chasing each other around the obstacles! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41417947/ade2c0be024f9f07758f2db836889137773a3da4.png[/img]

notes.title: Powerups, map display and more!
notes.content:
Patch notes: 

- Picture of the map when you choose. It shows up when you select it
- Powerups
      - When they’re taken, they should disappear until you can pick them up again
      - On your screen it’ll show you what powerup you have and how long you have left
- Updated timer and ‘it’ text to be the right font
- Fixed issue with multiple people being ‘it’ in the Normal Tag game
- People who are ‘it’ can now get the powerups

We experimented a lot with the powerups and we think these changes will make the game much more fun, especially the 'it' people being able to grab the powerups now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41417947/8f642c3ae81a30d37cced542a13dc1f34ddf293a.png[/img]

notes.title: First update: Lots of fixes
notes.content:
List of updates: 

- Updated Tutorial Button
- Red border around the screen when you’re it, making it more obvious to players when they’re it
- You can now rotate the character in the customization screen
- Reduced map 4 jet sound effect
- Fixed ground clipping on map 4
- Description of the game modes when you select them

We have another update coming out very soon and we are going to keep working hard on improving Ultimate TAG! We hope you're all having fun!
